title: FilTube
tagline: First ever decentralized video sharing & social media platform on Filecoin blockchain.
description:
FilTube uploads the video files to IPFS by using web3.storage and stores those IPFS CIDs to the Filecoin blockchain network.

- Storing any media on the blockchain is so costly, hence FilTube solves this problem by storing videos to IPFS using web3.storage and then IPFS CIDs to the blockchain.

- On FilTube Nobody can take down your videos.

- It's green as compared to the energy consumption of centralized servers like YouTube.

- It's ad-free! Now you can watch videos without those annoying ads, this platform treats you as a "user" not the "product".
how_its_made:
* Languages: Solidity, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
* Libraries: React.js, Web3.js, Bootstrap
* Tools: IPFS, Web3.storage
* Platforms: Fleek.co, truffle
* Blockchain: Filecoin
